## Description
Briefly describe the changes introduced in this pull request and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Security enhancement (hardens IPC, sandboxing, or cryptographic handshakes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`cargo fmt` / standard TS formatting).
- [ ] I have run `npm run test:security` and all security tests pass.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if adding new capabilities or IPC commands.
- [ ] My changes do not expose unauthorized file system paths or arbitrary shell execution.
